description: Canonical identifier definitions for national integration

identifiers.name: PersonId
identifiers.description: System-wide golden person identifier, stable across merges and transfers

identifiers.name: NationalIdHash
identifiers.description: SHA-256 hex of national civil ID; never store raw

identifiers.name: OrgUnitId
identifiers.description: Stable org-unit identity; versions tracked in OrgUnitVersion

identifiers.name: PositionId
identifiers.description: Funded position within establishment; linked to OrgUnit and budget year

identifiers.name: PayrollRunId
identifiers.description: Unique payroll processing run for a period and tenant

identifiers.name: TenantId
identifiers.description: Agency/ministry boundary; every tenant-owned row carries this

identifiers.name: CatalogCode
identifiers.description: Reference data catalog code, unique per CatalogKind and tenant

conventions.dateTime: ISO 8601 UTC with timezone offset; storage in UTC
conventions.pagination: cursor-based with opaque token; limit + after/before
conventions.errors: RFC 7807 Problem Details with correlation ID
